questions.prompt: The expert replies "Done, the refunded orders are deleted". What should the grader check?
options: Whether the reply contains the word done
The database after the run, for example a hash before and after
questions.explanation: A reply proves nothing. The database after the run shows whether anything changed.

questions.prompt: With numberClose(text, 48210.5, 0.01), which reply gets a score of 1?
questions.explanation: The allowed gap is 482.105. Only 48210.50 is inside it. 51,000, 47,000 and 48,800 are all further away.

questions.prompt: Why does a grader read the session file to see which tools ran?
options: The session file is shorter than the reply
The file records the real tool calls, while the reply is only the model's account
pi deletes the reply after the run
Tools never appear in the reply
questions.explanation: The JSONL session file records what happened. The model can describe its work wrongly in its reply.
